content:
Alisa: Dropped a new compact-rows mock for the Credentials page. Trying to show more keys without losing clarity. Figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-mock
Mike: Looks good visually. Two concerns: touch targets and audit info. Please keep interactive hits >=44px and don’t remove created/last-used timestamps entirely.
Sasha: Agree on timestamps. Could hide them in a details panel per row instead of the main table. Also inline revoke feels risky when visible by default. Suggest move revoke into kebab or require a confirm step.
Dinesh: Dev note: we have an experimental undo endpoint but feature flag is off in staging. @ui-bot, can you confirm flag name?
ui-bot: Feature flag `revoke_undo_v2` = off in staging. Backend route POST /keys/{id}/undo exists but is throttled and not GA.
Priya: Copy suggestions: revoke modal should be explicit. Proposed: "Revoke API key — this will stop calls immediately. If undo is available it will be shown after action." If flag off, show: "This action cannot be undone."
Alisa: For empty state in compact mode I propose: Title: "No API keys yet" Body: "Create an API key to start calling Redwood Inference. Use scoped permissions to limit access." Primary CTA: "Create API key" Secondary link: "Key scopes & best practices"
Mike: Accessibility checklist before PR: 1) keyboard nav & focus order tested, 2) role/pill chips have aria-labels (e.g., "permission: admin"), 3) modals use focus trap + aria-live for status, 4) color contrast >=4.5:1, 5) interactive targets >=44px. Add these to PR template.
Sasha: Also add: when showing undo toast make the undo button keyboard-focusable and ensure SR reads both revoke and undo possibilities.
Alisa: Action items: 1) I’ll update figma: keep row min-height 44px, details flyout for timestamps, move revoke behind kebab with confirm modal, conditional revoke copy based on `revoke_undo_v2`, and new empty-state copy. 2) Priya/Mike please add a11y checklist to PR template. Will ping when ready for review.
